what_this_proves: 6 of the 13 commands (doctor, init, intake, profile, compile-pi, validate) executed the genuine pipd_ls_sp source modules (pipd_ls_sp.cli -> pipeline/profiles/workspace/registry/requirements/validate) via PYTHONPATH only, no install, no site-packages write, exit codes from a real process. doctor resolved the 19-family registry from the SBL source tree (mode=SOURCE) and reported families=19, skill_drift=[]. init created the 5-dir skeleton and independently loaded the same 19-family registry. intake compiled clause-bound atoms from a real file, each atom carrying file+span+source_sha256 (offset-bound, not keyword-bucketed). compile-pi produced PI-5f7bc4f92d37f6e6 with 7 atoms, 7 TraceLinks, content_hash 5f7bc4f9..., and --replay reported identity_equal=true / replay_verdict=PASS on a second in-process compile. validate loaded the PI-PKG schema through the same SOURCE registry, ran the real jsonschema Draft202012 validator, and returned PASS checked=1 closure=FULL findings=[]. doctor's post-init FAIL is a genuine fail-closed check, not a stub: it ANDs the workspace-local schemas surface with the resolved one and honestly names the empty <root>/schemas registry.json it created. Failures are typed envelopes (IO_NOT_FOUND) on stdout with empty stderr, never tracebacks.
what_this_does_not_prove: Only 6/13 commands ran: bind-pd, compile-ecp, compile-tqaep, project, export, diff and repair (and thus the PD/ConstructionContract/ECP/TQAEP families and any projection or portable-bundle write path) are UNEXERCISED by this slice. Nothing here proves the full 19-family artifact chain, only PI-PKG end-to-end. No authority freeze (freeze_authority) was exercised: intake accepted a direct --source locator, so the AuthorityBinding/SourceFreezeManifest admission path is untested. Only the SOURCE schemas surface was resolved; the INSTALLED (wheel) and OVERRIDE ($PIPD_SCHEMAS_DIR) modes were not tested because nothing was installed. No independent checker or S5 runtime verification took place; TQAEP/ClaimCeiling ceilings are not demonstrated. The CLI was driven by a hand-authored 4-clause fixture, so clause-count/complexity behaviour on real SBL source documents (compound/negated/ambiguous clauses) is not evidenced. This says nothing about SBL repo governance, the TPM adapter, Family coverage claims, or whether the 13-command surface satisfies 總藍圖 §5.9.3 beyond the exact-set check visible in --help.
